title: AI that works while you sleep
frame1Text: Your to-do list, done by morning.
armature: AI agents now act, not just answer: they browse, handle email and calendar, research and build files, and run on a schedule, so you can wake up to finished work.

heygen.motion_prompt_hook: Asks the question to the viewer with natural hand gestures like talking to a friend, leans slightly toward the camera, small curious eyebrow raise, natural blinking.
heygen.motion_prompt_close: Talks with natural hand gestures like explaining something to a friend, leans slightly toward the camera, nods once at the end, natural blinking.

scenes.title: Your to-do list, done by morning.
scenes.narration: What if AI could work for you while you're sleeping?

scenes.label: the agent drives
scenes.title: Hands off the mouse.
scenes.narration: AI agents can open websites, click buttons, fill out forms, and complete tasks for you.

scenes.label: plug in your apps
scenes.narration: Connect your email and calendar, and they can find important messages, prepare replies, and organize your schedule.

scenes.title: A vs B, in rows.
scenes.narration: Need competitor research? They'll compare websites and build a spreadsheet.

scenes.title: Slides: handled.
scenes.narration: Need a presentation? They'll create one.

scenes.title: Set it once.
scenes.narration: You can schedule tasks to run automatically.

scenes.title: 7:00 AM
scenes.narration: Imagine waking up to your emails summarized, your business metrics analyzed, and your reports ready.

scenes.title: Already here.
scenes.narration: Tools like ChatGPT Work and Claude Cowork are making this possible.
sources: Nombres tal como los escribió Enrico. Claude Cowork es el modo de agente de escritorio de Anthropic; 'ChatGPT Work' no verificado por Claude. Marcas tipografiadas en pills, sin logos.

scenes.title: Less talk. More action.
scenes.narration: AI isn't just answering questions anymore. It's getting things done.
